title: Struk di Dompetmu
subject: a woman in Depok who borrows her boyfriend's wallet for parking change and finds a folded stack of every minimarket coffee receipt from their first month together, which he has kept without telling her
caption: Indonesian minimalist poetic chamber pop in the mid-2020s Jakarta songwriter style. String quartet with slow sustained cello and pizzicato violins, felt grand piano playing sparse broken chords, nylon-string guitar fingerpicking, soft upright bass. Dry intimate room mix with close mics and audible bow noise. Male tenor, soft close conversational delivery, gentle falsetto on the last chorus line. 76 BPM, E-flat major. Tender, shy, quietly glad. No autotune, no trap drums, no EDM build, no rock drums, no gospel choir.
lyrics:
[Intro - felt piano and cello]

[Verse 1]
Kamu pinjam dompetku
Cari receh buat parkir
Yang jatuh malah kertas
Lipatan struk kopi

[Pre-Chorus]
Tanggalnya kamu baca satu-satu
Aku pura-pura lihat spion

[Chorus]
Itu struk di dompetku
Kopi susu, dua gelas
Hari Senin kamu telat
Kamis kamu ketawa

[Verse 2]
Kertasnya sudah pudar
Tintanya hampir hilang
Kamu bilang aku aneh
Tapi struknya kamu simpan

[Bridge - pizzicato strings]
Yang paling kusut di bawah
Hari pertama kamu bilang iya

[Chorus]
Itu struk di dompetku
Kopi susu, dua gelas
Sekarang kamu yang simpan
Di dompetmu, paling atas

[Outro - string quartet fades]
